summary: A04 (TF-0296) A4 decision-quality pilot re-verification is implemented and evidence-backed. Changed/added: harness/specs/tasks/a4-decision-quality-pilot.md (original 10% threshold, sampling-rate 1.0, degrade_to_audit_only and A4→A3→A5→A1 texts kept verbatim; requiredTests drift fixed; new evidenceGaps block declares every test absent from this snapshot), harness/specs/tasks/harness-gap-a04-decision-quality-pilot-reverify.md, tests/unit/decision-quality-auditor.test.ts, tests/unit/deep/a4-deep.test.ts, tests/unit/a04-a4-gate-coverage.test.ts, docs/dev/harness-gap-closure/a04-decision-quality-gate.md, a04-acceptance.json, A04-SHA256SUMS. Verdicts, all grounded in artifacts on disk: criterion 1 PASS (<=10%, exact-10% boundary does not trip), criterion 3 PASS (>10% -> a4_low_quality_rate / degrade_to_audit_only), criterion 2 module-level PASS (auditBatch charges one audited decision per record) but PRODUCTION coverage NO-GO (development-manual §1.4 makes A4 offline/dev-tool-only; a repo-wide search finds no DecisionQualityAuditor caller), criterion 4 order PASS (spanDropPriority core<a6<a1<a2<a5<a3<a4, asserted in tests/unit/observability-namespace.test.ts) but the per-turn cumulative latency number NOT-MEASURED/NO-GO (A4 never runs on a production turn). Overall decision.status = NO-GO: A4 does not graduate, stays offline/dev-tool-only, no product-lock change. Important honesty notes: this workspace has no git metadata and no node_modules, so nothing was installed, no network was used and no vitest/typecheck/eslint/comms gate is claimed; A4 behaviour was instead executed directly against the real source modules with a temporary Node type-stripping harness, and the three test files were run through a minimal vitest shim (8/8, 10/10, 5/5). tests/unit/deprecation-counters.test.ts, the upstream tests/unit/deep/a4-deep.test.ts, tests/unit/trace-truncation.test.ts and tests/unit/performance-budgets.test.ts are absent from this snapshot (they exist in the frozen release source, artifacts/system-maturity/P6-005/release-source-manifest.json @819338bc), so they are declared as evidence gaps and covered by in-tree equivalents rather than claimed as passing. All temp files were removed afterwards.
